Name: Clay Quarry
Author: KittyKaninka
Description:
[size=4][b]Ever thought it was impossible to find clay?[/b][/size]
[size=2]Well not anymore.[/size]

[size=2]This mod adds a small area that you access from the quarry. Here there is an almost guaranteed chance of finding clay when digging in the ground.[/size]
[size=2]Although to keep it from being too much like cheating, it is a rather small area, so you are limited in how much clay you can dig up each day.[/size]


[size=2]Generic Mod Config Menu is not required for the mod to work, but adds a few customisation options that might be nice.[/size]


[b][size=4]Is compatible with:[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255][size=2]Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolour[/size][/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34617][size=2]Miner's Retreat - A Quarry Expansion[/size][/url]

Manifest.Name: Clay Quarry
Manifest.Description: Adds an opening in the quarry which gives acces to a mini quarry where you can mine clay.
Manifest.Author: Kitty Kaninka
